content.text:
I haven't approved DR-17.

The operator notice lets you approve discount requests in Nikos's place only for the fair week, Monday 16 to Friday 20 November. You mentioned he left a day early, which suggests that week hasn't started yet. I can't treat an early departure as moving the start date. The notice also doesn't extend your cover to the 23rd.

To get Thistlewick an answer before the weekend, ask Owen Hale (owen@ottermere.example). He's in Finance and can approve DR-17 now. If it's still waiting once the week starts on the 16th, send it back to me and I can approve it for you then.
